description: Tekil sayılabilir isimden önce a/an ya da the eksik.
examples: I have car. → I have a car.
She is teacher. → She is a teacher.
Close door, please. → Close the door, please.

description: Yanlış artikel: a yerine an ya da the, ya da tersi.
examples: I ate a apple. → I ate an apple.
It's a hour. → It's an hour.
A sun is hot. → The sun is hot.

description: Genel anlamda kullanılan isimden önce gereksiz the.
examples: The life is beautiful. → Life is beautiful.
I like the music. → I like music.
The cats are cute. → Cats are cute.

description: am/is/are eksik: Türkçedeki ek gibi düşürülmüş.
examples: I happy. → I am happy.
She tired. → She is tired.
They at home. → They are at home.

description: Yalın fiilin önüne gereksiz am/is/are eklenmiş: asıl fiil varken be yalnızca -ing ile gelir.
examples: I am agree. → I agree.
She is work in a bank. → She works in a bank.
Are you like coffee? → Do you like coffee?

description: he/she/it ile fiildeki -s eksik ya da gereksiz yerde.
examples: He work every day. → He works every day.
She don't like it. → She doesn't like it.
Does he works here? → Does he work here?

description: Soru ya da olumsuz cümlede do/does/did eksik.
examples: You like coffee? → Do you like coffee?
I not understand. → I don't understand.
Where you went? → Where did you go?

description: Soru sırası yanlış: be ya da do özneden önce gelmemiş.
examples: Where you are? → Where are you?
What you are doing? → What are you doing?
Why she is sad? → Why is she sad?

description: Fiil Türkçedeki gibi sona gitmiş; İngilizcede fiil özneden hemen sonra gelir.
examples: I coffee drink. → I drink coffee.
She English speaks. → She speaks English.
We to the park went. → We went to the park.

description: Sıklık ya da zaman zarfı yanlış yerde.
examples: I drink always tea. → I always drink tea.
She is late never. → She is never late.
I every day walk. → I walk every day.

description: he, she ve it karışmış: Türkçedeki tek "o" yerine cinsiyete göre seçilmemiş.
examples: My sister is a doctor. He works at night. → She works at night.
My father? She is fine. → He is fine.
I like this car. She is fast. → It is fast.

description: Özne düşmüş: İngilizcede her cümlenin öznesi söylenir.
examples: Is raining. → It is raining.
Am very tired. → I am very tired.
Is a nice day. → It is a nice day.

description: Nesne zamiri yerine özne biçimi kullanılmış ya da nesne düşmüş.
examples: She loves he. → She loves him.
Can you help I? → Can you help me?
Do you like it? Yes, I like. → Yes, I like it.

description: Sahiplik yanlış gösterilmiş: his/her karışmış ya da 's eksik.
examples: My mother has his own car. → My mother has her own car.
This is Ali car. → This is Ali's car.
My sister name is Elif. → My sister's name is Elif.

description: Çoğul eki eksik: Türkçede sayıdan ve "birçok" gibi sözcüklerden sonra isim tekil kalır (iki kitap), İngilizcede çoğul olur (two books, many books).
examples: I have two brother. → I have two brothers.
Three book are on the table. → Three books are on the table.
Many student live here. → Many students live here.

description: Sayılamayan isme çoğul eki ya da a/an eklenmiş.
examples: I need some informations. → I need some information.
She gave me an advice. → She gave me some advice.
The furnitures are new. → The furniture is new.

description: much ile many ya da some ile any karışmış.
examples: How much books do you have? → How many books do you have?
I don't have many money. → I don't have much money.
I didn't buy some bread. → I didn't buy any bread.

description: "var" yanlış çevrilmiş: bir yerde bir şey varsa there is/are, birinin bir şeyi varsa have.
examples: In my room have a table. → There is a table in my room.
There is a car of my father. → My father has a car.
Have a problem here. → There is a problem here.

description: Geniş zaman ile şimdiki zaman karışmış: alışkanlık için -ing kullanılmış ya da tersi.
examples: I am drinking coffee every morning. → I drink coffee every morning.
Look! It rains. → Look! It's raining.
What do you do now? → What are you doing now?

description: did/didn't'tan sonra fiilin geçmiş biçimi kullanılmış ya da düzensiz fiile -ed eklenmiş.
examples: Did you went there? → Did you go there?
I didn't saw him. → I didn't see him.
We goed home. → We went home.

description: Geçmişte olan iş için fiil geçmiş biçime konmamış: -ed ya da düzensiz geçmiş biçim yok.
examples: Yesterday I watch a film. → Yesterday I watched a film.
Last year we go to Izmir. → Last year we went to Izmir.
She call me last night. → She called me last night.

description: Present perfect ile geçmiş zaman karışmış: zamanı belli olan geçmişte present perfect kullanılmış ya da tersi.
examples: I have seen him yesterday. → I saw him yesterday.
I lived here since 2020. → I have lived here since 2020.
I have visited Italy in 2020. → I visited Italy in 2020.

description: Gelecek biçimi yanlış: will ya da going to'dan sonra fiil yalın değil, ya da be eksik.
examples: I will to call you. → I will call you.
I going to visit them. → I'm going to visit them.
It will rains. → It will rain.

description: can, must, should gibi sözcüklerden sonra to gelmiş ya da bu sözcüklere veya ardındaki fiile -s eklenmiş.
examples: I can to swim. → I can swim.
She cans drive. → She can drive.
You should to see a doctor. → You should see a doctor.

description: Fiilden sonraki fiilin biçimi yanlış: to, -ing ya da yalın hâl karışmış.
examples: I enjoy to swim. → I enjoy swimming.
I want going home. → I want to go home.
She likes cook. → She likes cooking.

description: Karşılaştırma ya da en üstünlük yanlış kurulmuş: kısa sıfatla more/most, more ile -er birlikte ya da than yerine from.
examples: It is more bigger. → It is bigger.
She is taller from me. → She is taller than me.
This is the most big house. → This is the biggest house.

description: Yaş Türkçedeki kalıpla söylenmiş: yaşta be ve How old kullanılır.
examples: How many years are you? → How old are you?
I'm thirty years. → I'm thirty years old.
My son is five age. → My son is five.

description: in, on ve at karışmış.
examples: I'm free in Monday. → I'm free on Monday.
The film starts on seven. → The film starts at seven.
The keys are in the table. → The keys are on the table.

description: Edat eksik ya da fazla; bazı fiiller Türkçedekinden farklı edat alır.
examples: I went to home. → I went home.
I'm listening music. → I'm listening to music.
Let's discuss about it. → Let's discuss it.

description: say ile tell karışmış: tell'den sonra doğrudan kişi gelir (tell me), say'den sonra gelmez (say to me).
examples: He said me the answer. → He told me the answer.
Tell hello to her. → Say hello to her.
She told that she was tired. → She said that she was tired.

description: make ile do karışmış: ikisi de "yapmak" ama farklı kelimelerle kullanılır.
examples: I make my homework. → I do my homework.
Can you do a cake? → Can you make a cake?
He did a mistake. → He made a mistake.

description: see, look ve watch karışmış: görmek see, bakmak look at, izlemek watch.
examples: I'm looking TV. → I'm watching TV.
I see TV every evening. → I watch TV every evening.
Can you watch the sea from here? → Can you see the sea from here?

description: Işık ve cihazlar için "açmak/kapatmak" open/close ile çevrilmiş; doğrusu turn on/off.
examples: Open the light. → Turn on the light.
Close the TV. → Turn off the TV.
Can you open the radio? → Can you turn on the radio?

description: Türkçedeki benzer kelimeye güvenilmiş (yanlış arkadaş).
examples: My father works in a fabric. (fabrika anlamında) → My father works in a factory.
He is very sympathetic. (sempatik anlamında) → He is very nice.
It's an actual topic. (güncel anlamında) → It's a current topic.

description: Türkçedeki "çok" fiille very olarak kullanılmış; fiili niteleyen çok için cümle sonunda very much ya da a lot gelir.
examples: I very like it. → I like it very much.
I very love you. → I love you very much.
She works very. → She works a lot.

description: th sesleri /θ/ ve /ð/ yerine t, d, s ya da z söylenmiş.
examples: tink → think
dis → this
tree (three demek istenirken) → three

description: /w/ yerine /v/ söylenmiş: dudaklar yuvarlanmadan.
examples: vork → work
vine (wine demek istenirken) → wine
vee → we

description: Kısa ve uzun ünlüler ya da /æ/ ile /e/ ayrılmamış.
examples: ship (sheep demek istenirken) → sheep
live (leave demek istenirken) → leave
bed (bad demek istenirken) → bad

description: Kelime yazıldığı gibi okunmuş: sessiz harfler ya da -ed sonu.
examples: /wɔːlk/ → /wɔːk/ (walk: l okunmaz)
/ˈwɜːkɪd/ → /wɜːkt/ (worked: -ed ayrı hece olmaz)
/ˈwednesdeɪ/ → /ˈwenzdeɪ/ (Wednesday)

description: Ünsüz kümesinin başına ya da arasına ünlü eklenmiş.
examples: istation → station
sipik → speak
tireyn → train

description: Kelime sonundaki b, d, g sesleri Türkçedeki gibi (kitap, kitabı) ötümsüz söylenmiş: p, t, k.
examples: back (bag demek istenirken) → bag
bet (bed demek istenirken) → bed
dock (dog demek istenirken) → dog

description: Vurgu Türkçedeki gibi son heceye konmuş; İngilizcede vurgulu hece kelimeye göre değişir ve çoğu zaman sonda değildir.
examples: probLEM → PROBlem
interNET → INternet
proGRAM → PROgram

description: Hızlı konuşmadaki zayıf biçimler duyulmamış (can/can't, to, of, and).
examples: I can go → I can't go (dikte; kayıtta can't)
a cup tea → a cup of tea (dikte)
I want go → I want to go (dikte)

description: Kelime sonundaki -s ya da -ed duyulmamış.
examples: She work → She works (dikte)
We watch a film → We watched a film (dikte)
two book → two books (dikte)

description: İstek fazla doğrudan: İngilizcede kibar kalıplar (Can I…?, Could you…?, please) beklenir.
examples: Give me a coffee. → Can I have a coffee, please?
Say again. → Sorry, can you say that again?
I want the bill. → Can I have the bill, please?
